The '''Ralltiir Corps''' was a military unit in service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Army|army]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. It contained the [[Brigade/Legends|brigade]]-sized [[Telerath 2nd]] and [[Serroco Colonial]], as well as the smaller [[Graayson's Company]] which reported directly to [[Corps Command]]. The [[Corps/Legends|Corps]] shared its name with<ref name="KOTOR guide" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]].<ref name="Core Worlds">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Ralltiir Corps was mentioned in the ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2008]] supplement to [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', in "Chapter XI: The Republic,"<ref name="KOTOR guide" /> a chapter that was written by [[John Jackson Miller]].<ref name="Miller Campaign">{{Faraway|url=games/swkotorguide.html|text=Star Wars Roleplaying Game: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide}}</ref>
